Persist Profile-scoped Issue aliases and freeze Issue prefixes

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-22
  description: |-
    Add a durable Profile-scoped alias namespace that maps Workspace keys and Issue prefixes onto one Workspace owner, with lowercase comparison aliases, same-owner collapse, and a clear migration failure for cross-Workspace collisions.
    
    Workspace creation writes both aliases in the existing receipt transaction. Prefix updates reserve idempotency, lock the Workspace row shared with Issue creation, no-op on normalized equality, reject a material change with PrefixAlreadyInUse after any Issue exists, and otherwise replace the alias and prefix atomically while appending the existing bounded event.
    
    A focused PostgreSQL resolver maps Profile, IssueReference, and optional expected Workspace through alias roles and Issue number to IssueId, returning preferred uppercase prefix and legacy key forms. Expected-Workspace mismatch is not found. Historical Issue identifiers are left unchanged.
